tools.name: list_lifecycle_definitions
tools.description: List packaged and registered lifecycle definitions.

tools.name: get_lifecycle_definition
tools.description: Retrieve one versioned data-only lifecycle definition.

tools.name: register_lifecycle_definition
tools.description: Register an immutable validated definition; no executable configuration.

tools.name: enroll_lifecycle
tools.description: Explicitly enroll a draft revision; no historical PASS states are inherited.

tools.name: get_project_lifecycle
tools.description: Read lifecycle stages and effective evidence/dependency/review blockers.

tools.name: get_lifecycle_history
tools.description: Read append-only lifecycle history with sequence pagination.

tools.name: apply_lifecycle_stage
tools.description: Start/reopen/block/fail/request review/attach validation evidence/complete a stage. Completion is guarded; no approval operation.

tools.name: get_project_metadata
tools.description: Read project metadata including the optimistic-concurrency updated_at token.

tools.name: update_project_metadata
tools.description: Update project metadata using the existing service with idempotency and concurrency guards.

tools.name: record_requirements
tools.description: Append structured sourced requirements for an active lifecycle attempt; does not approve requirements.

tools.name: list_requirements
tools.description: Read revision-associated requirements history.

tools.name: get_requirement_coverage
tools.description: Find missing declared inputs/criteria; no standards or engineering approval inferred.

tools.name: list_supported_calculations
tools.description: Discover existing deterministic calculators, required inputs/units and implementation caveats.

tools.name: record_calculation_run
tools.description: Run an existing calculator and persist exact inputs/results/assumptions/source digest without duplicating formulas.

tools.name: list_calculation_runs
tools.description: Read persisted calculation history, including warnings and specification staleness.

tools.name: get_engineering_record
tools.description: Read a hash-checked engineering record and current effective integrity/staleness.

tools.name: register_engineering_artifact
tools.description: Register a confined revision file, preserving a unique immutable copy and original hash.

tools.name: list_registered_artifacts
tools.description: Read registered artifacts with missing/changed original and snapshot checks.

tools.name: record_validation_evidence
tools.description: Delegate explicit numerical evidence recording to the existing validation service. Reviewer identity remains unverified.

tools.name: get_validation_results
tools.description: Read effective validation status from shared core integrity checks.

tools.name: get_simulation_status
tools.description: Read persisted execution state and this session's actual cancellation capability.

tools.name: get_simulation_logs
tools.description: Read available bounded persisted job logs; absence is not success.

tools.name: get_simulation_results
tools.description: Read persisted job results and evidence integrity, separately from engineering validation.

tools.name: get_simulation_artifact
tools.description: Preview manifest-checked available text output; no hidden waveform transformation.

tools.name: cancel_simulation_job
tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation only for jobs owned by this session; foreign jobs are not relabelled cancelled.

tools.name: generate_revision_report
tools.description: Use the existing report generator with stage attribution, file hashes and idempotency.

tools.name: get_report_metadata
tools.description: Read report availability/staleness and known integrity; legacy authenticity may be unverified.

tools.name: list_revision_reports
tools.description: List existing report metadata for a revision.

tools.name: export_report_package
tools.description: Export a unique local ZIP of the existing report and frozen snapshot, retaining integrity/provenance caveats.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists all authoritative engineering projects and active baseline revisions.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Creates a new authoritative engineering project with baseline specifications and storage.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive engineering project status, specifications, revisions, and evidence.

tools.name: get_project_specifications
tools.description: Retrieves electrical specifications and physical hash for an engineering project.

tools.name: save_project_specification
tools.description: Persists validated operating specifications to an engineering project.

spec_data.description: Electrical specification object containing vin_nom_v, vout_v, etc.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Deletes an engineering project, its revisions, jobs, and workspace files.

project_id.description: Project UUID or code to delete

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists all active engineering workspaces and product workspaces.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Creates a new engineering workspace for design generation, simulation, and artifacts.

tools.name: get_workspace_status
tools.description: Returns status, directories, design counts, and simulation history of a workspace.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists all authoritative engineering products stored in SQLite.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Creates a new authoritative engineering product and initial baseline revision.

tools.name: delete_product
tools.description: Deletes an engineering product, its revisions, and directory contents.

product_id.description: Product UUID or product code to delete

tools.name: validate_specification
tools.description: Validates electrical operating parameters against SI schema and physical constraints.

spec_data.description: Electrical specification object containing vin_nom_v, vout_v, iout_a, etc.

tools.name: save_specification
tools.description: Persists an updated electrical specification to a product revision.

tools.name: generate_design
tools.description: Synthesizes candidate converter topologies, sizes components, and generates native CAD artifacts (.kicad_sch, .kicad_pcb, .asc, .net, .step).

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Retrieves synthesized engineering design details, component values, and topology.

tools.name: list_design_candidates
tools.description: Lists all candidate topologies synthesized for an engineering design with feasibility scores.

tools.name: run_engineering_calculations
tools.description: Executes first-principles deterministic engineering calculations: 'dowell' (winding losses), 'losses' (MOSFET switching/conduction), 'steinmetz' (core loss), or 'flyback' (transformer sizing).

tools.name: run_simulation
tools.description: Executes headless industrial simulation (LTspice transient or FEMM magnetics) on generated netlists.

netlist_name.description: Optional specific netlist (.net / .cir) or script (.lua) filename

tools.name: list_simulations
tools.description: Lists simulation jobs and execution status.

tools.name: list_design_artifacts
tools.description: Lists all CAD schematics (.kicad_sch), PCB layouts (.kicad_pcb), SPICE netlists (.asc/.net), 3D STEP solids (.step), and simulation waveforms (.raw) in a workspace.

tools.name: open_artifact
tools.description: Opens a native design artifact in the host's specialized CAD application (KiCad, LTspice, or FreeCAD).

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Lists external host engineering tools (LTspice, KiCad, FEMM, FreeCAD) and their operational status.

tools.name: check_tool
tools.description: Performs a live diagnostic health check on an engineering tool.

tools.name: open_tool_file
tools.description: Launches a native tool directly with a specified engineering file.

tools.name: list_revisions
tools.description: Lists all revision snapshots and specification hashes for a product.

tools.name: create_revision
tools.description: Creates a new immutable revision baseline for a product.

tools.name: get_validation_summary
tools.description: Returns formal engineering validation summary and gate status for a revision.

tools.name: generate_engineering_report
tools.description: Generates a formal, immutable engineering dossier report (HTML + JSON snapshot with SHA-256).

revision_id.description: Product revision UUID (optional; defaults to first active)
